items.title: Ed Shaughnessy Part II interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 25, 1998 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: And after we get done she comes up to me and she says “you heard the record.”

ctx.x: You fellas on The Tonight Show must have been monstrous readers.

Oh yeah, you had to be a cracker jack reader, yeah. Because the music came in at 3:15. You had a chance to play the tune once to make sure there was no wrong notes and kind of make sure there were no problems. Then the artist would go out at the mic as if it was the real show, without their costume on, and they’d put the lights on and everything looked like a show, and we’d play it a second time, and then the third time was during the show. So I’m not saying we couldn’t play it another time, but on the average we…
